name: @fyeeme/pi-review
description: Review & cleanup extension for pi. Registers /code-review and /code-simplify commands plus a general-purpose `subagent` tool that spawns parallel pi subprocesses — providing the real fan-out capability the code-review and simplify skills (bundled under `skills/`) need for their multi-agent flows. The /code-simplify handler uses ctx.getContextUsage() to decide parallel vs single-pass mode deterministically.
author: fyeeme
